methods.name: placeOrder
methods.signature: Order placeOrder(String customerId, List<OrderItem> items, PaymentDetails payment)
methods.rationale: Multi-step flow spanning inventory reservation, payment capture, and persistence — partial failure at any step requires careful rollback to avoid inventory leaks or double charges.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.rationale: Triggers a payment refund and inventory release; incorrect status transitions or refund failures directly impact customers and finances.

methods.name: totalAmount
methods.rationale: Monetary calculation with a hardcoded tax rate; precision errors or incorrect rounding propagate directly to customer charges.

methods.name: summarize
methods.rationale: Read-only string formatting for logging with no business logic or side effects.
